facts.fact: A page contributes at most 26 passages; the rest is never read.
Long sections are cut into 2,000-character windows with 200 characters of overlap.
Only an h2 starts a passage; an h3 stays inside the passage of the h2 above it.
The grouping embeds each passage after the cut; the cut itself is not semantic.
A test of one URL takes about twenty seconds.
Free with a rate limit, no account; the fetched page is not retained.
